raw_output:
Giver: Right, let's start at the bottom left. Where did you mark your start?
Follower: Oh, got it. The cross is near the bottom left corner.
Giver: Good. Okay, from there, you need to go up and slightly left, past the telephone kiosk, but keep the kiosk on your left side as you move up.
Follower: Left of the kiosk? Okay, I'm drawing a line going up the left edge, keeping the kiosk to my left.
Giver: No, wait. You pass the kiosk. Keep it on your left as you walk away from it, moving towards the top of the map.
Follower: Ah, so I walk past it? Okay, I'm heading towards the top left now.
Giver: Yes, keep going straight up until you hit the very top edge of the map.
Follower: Okay, I'm at the top left corner now.
Giver: Great. Now turn right, go across the top, then turn left again, coming down just past the stone circle. Keep the stone circle on your left.
Follower: Stone circle... oh! That's near the bottom left on my map. Is that the stone circle?
Giver: Yeah, that's it. You'll see it's a circle of stones. Go past it, then head straight down towards the farmer's gate.
Follower: Farmer's gate? Wait, I have a broken gate there. Is that the one? And why is it further down than the stone circle on my map?
Giver: Yeah, it's the broken gate on the right side. Okay, draw a line from the top left, down past the stone circle on your left, then over to the broken gate.
Follower: Okay, I'm drawing that. So from the top left corner, down to the stone circle, then across to the gate.
Giver: Yes, that's right. Now, from the gate, head towards the meadow. Keep the meadow on your left.
Follower: Meadow is there... okay, heading towards it.
Giver: Wait, on my map, the meadow is near the bottom right, but you have it higher up. Does it matter? Just follow the line towards the bottom right corner.
Follower: Oh, okay. I'm drawing it towards the bottom right now.
Giver: Good. Keep going until you reach the bottom right corner. That's where you'll find the east lake.
Follower: East lake? I see a lake there, but it's pretty big.
Giver: Yep, the east lake. It's the one near the bottom right. Keep going up the right side of the map, past the lake.
Follower: Okay, moving up the right side. Wait, I see a rocket launch pad there. Is that part of the route?
Giver: No, ignore the rocket launch pad. Just keep walking up the right side. You'll hit a viewpoint soon.
Follower: Viewpoint! Oh, I see a great viewpoint up there. Is that the one?
Giver: Yes, the great viewpoint. Keep it on your left as you pass it. Then continue up and slightly right, ignoring that other viewpoint higher up.
Follower: Okay, I'm passing the viewpoint on the left. Now going towards the middle.
Giver: Yes. Now head towards the ruined monastery. Keep it on your left.
Follower: Ruined monastery? That's near the middle on my map. Okay, heading towards it.
Giver: Keep going until you're next to it, then turn right and walk towards the stile. Keep the stile on your right.
Follower: Stile! Oh, I see it. Okay, I'm walking towards it. Wait, my stile is slightly lower than yours, but I'll adjust.
Giver: Don't worry about the exact position, just get to the stile. Once you're there, turn left and head towards the dead tree. Keep the dead tree on your left.
Follower: Dead tree... oh, that's way up there! Okay, heading up.
Giver: Yes, the dead tree is higher up on my map. Keep going until you reach the great viewpoint again.
Follower: Great viewpoint? There are two of them now. Which one?
Giver: The one you passed earlier, the lower one. That's the one. Keep it on your left.
Follower: Okay, I'm at the lower viewpoint now. Heading towards the finish.
Giver: Yes, from here, just walk towards the finish. The finish is near the top middle.
Follower: Finish? I see a cross there!
Giver: Perfect. That's the finish. Make sure you end your line exactly on the cross.
Follower: Done! I've drawn the whole route.
Giver: Great job. Are you sure the line connects everything?
Follower: Yeah, looks good. Start, stone circle, broken gate, meadow, east lake, viewpoint, ruined monastery, stile, dead tree, and finish.
Giver: Perfect. You're done.
Follower: Okay, call ended. Thanks!
